name: Lab report
description: A university lab report: full title page, running header, and Aim → Theory → Method → Results → Discussion.
notes: `titlepage` gives an unnumbered page of its own. `\vfill` pushes the details to the bottom.
Header/footer are set with `fancyhdr`. `\fancyhf{}` clears the defaults first.
Use `siunitx` for every measured value so units and uncertainties stay consistent.
